geometry: Equivalent sphere per native inventory unit, additive across units. This is a contact-area convention, not a microscopic grain/pore measurement. Existing physical vessel/equipment dimensions take precedence.
authorization: Author authorized documented calculations for physical stackables; abstract preparations retain the explicitly approved 1000 kg/m3 convention.

Manufacturer sodium-stearate density; soap constituent used as an explicit geometry proxy, not a new formulation.

food_basis: Raw/cooked fish share FAO white-fish reference; raw/roast beef share FAO raw-meat proxy. Puchero uses FAO canned beef stew 1050; bread uses FAO white bread 420. Generic ration, mixture and dough retain the abstract-preparation convention. Cooking does not change mass or nutrition here.
